title: Surface Area of 3D Shapes
summary: Given an n x n grid with cubes placed on each cell, where the value v at grid[i][j] indicates a tower of v cubes, calculate the total surface area of the 3D shapes formed by gluing adjacent cubes.
statement: Given an n x n grid with cubes placed on each cell, where the value v at grid[i][j] indicates a tower of v cubes, calculate the total surface area of the 3D shapes formed by gluing adjacent cubes. The bottom face of each shape is included in the surface area.
constraints: Each grid value is the height of a unit-cube stack.
Return total exposed top, bottom, and side area.
hints: Each nonempty stack contributes top/bottom plus four vertical sides, reduced by shared faces with neighbors.
Add isolated-stack area and subtract twice each shared boundary with top/left neighbors.
For height h add 2+4h; subtract 2*min(h,neighbor) for each processed adjacency.
Every cube face is initially counted, and each internal touching pair removes its two hidden faces exactly once.
editorial: Every cube face is initially counted, and each internal touching pair removes its two hidden faces exactly once.

tests.explanation: Adding exposed faces and subtracting shared faces gives total 34.
A two-cube vertical stack exposes ten faces.
